request.subject: CITY:GOBLIN:2

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the black platform and its red rim under the camp, so the spiked iron fence, the tents and the tower stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the red patched tents, the dark hut, the grey iron lookout tower, the red flag, the chimney pipe with grey smoke, the spiked fence, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
